correctness.rationale: Define D=GP(6,2) on vertices u_i,v_i (i mod6), with outer, spoke and inner-step-two edges. Ind_2(D) comprises subsets inducing components of order <=2; equivalently forbids any connected induced 3-set. Independent enumeration of all 2^12 masks finds 32 forbidden triples and 809 nonempty faces, f=(12,66,188,285,204,54). The explicit vertex toggle order 2,11,10,0,6,8,7,1,5,9,3,4 gives 402 disjoint matching pairs, one critical vertex, three critical 3-simplices and one critical 4-simplex. Directed cover graph with 3,180 relations topologically sorts completely. Independent exact signed gradient recursion projects the attaching degree of the sole 4-cell to (0,0,0). The three-skeleton is wedge of three S^3, its π3 ≅ H3 ≅ Z^3; zero degree vector makes the 4-cell null-attached, giving wedge^3 S^3 vee S^4. This is integral homotopy, not a deduction from mod-two homology.
